value.rationale: A natural degenerate-parameter boundary of fixed-parameter Aluthge iteration changes zero limits into a nonzero continuous semigroup. The exact positive Lévy measure forces the previously unavailable all-order complete monotonicity of Schatten traces, and the joint-parameter sharp decay characterizes every path across the boundary; this structural spectral regularity is not merely an extra decimal or a fixed-parameter rate refinement.
